title: Administration Charge on a Car Rental Settlement Raised on a Late Reading
content:
An administration charge is added once where the settlement on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes is raised on a reading taken after the booked return. The reading is the latest mileage movement standing against the rental, and it is taken after the booked return day where 1 or more whole days lie between the booked return and that movement.

**The administration schedule.**

| The chargeable miles, and when the reading was taken | Administration charge |
|---|---|
| 500 miles or more, the reading taken after the booked return day | 35.00 |
| 150 miles or more, the reading taken after the booked return day | 18.00 |
| Anything else | Nothing |

The charge is added once to the money charged for the chargeable miles, rather than to any earlier step.

**The two parts of each condition.** Each of the first two entitlements requires the overage and the late reading together. An overage of 900 chargeable miles read on the booked return day itself carries no administration charge, because no whole day lies between the booked return and the reading. An overage of 40 chargeable miles read 6 whole days after the booked return likewise carries none, the overage reaching neither threshold.

**Both sides of the thresholds, on hypothetical readings taken after the booked return day.**

| Chargeable miles | Administration charge |
|---|---|
| 620 | 35.00 |
| 500 | 35.00 |
| 499 | 18.00 |
| 150 | 18.00 |
| 149 | Nothing |
